name: ad-rto-sample
description: Sample RTO (Red Team Operations) playbook: verification-style checks corresponding to the findings in data/findings-sample.json. This is the tracked seed template; the live playbook (playbooks/rto.json, gitignored) is grown by exporting commands from successful retests. Variables: {{target}} {{domain}} {{user}} {{password}} {{dns}} plus extract-inherited (e.g. {{dcs}} {{dc}}). Conventions: (1) wrap {{password}}/{{user}} in '...' (the server escapes assuming injection inside '...'). (2) extract-inherited vars (e.g. {{dcs}}) are already individually shlex.quote'd, so use them as-is. (3) proxychains defaults to true; set false for local/ICMP/UDP. (4) attach judge:true + judge_criteria to check steps; leave prerequisite/collection steps unjudged.

groups.name: Initial recon / DC discovery (prerequisite, not shown in report)

steps.description: Create the Kali-side output directory (local operation, so proxychains disabled)
Discover DCs via the DNS SRV record _ldap._tcp.<domain> against {{dns}}. The server machine-extracts the output and injects {{dcs}}/{{dc}} server-side (no extract needed).

groups.name: Finding 1: SPN bound to a privileged account (Kerberoasting exposure)

steps.label: SPN on privileged account
steps.description: Check whether any high-privilege account (adminCount=1) still has a servicePrincipalName set.
steps.judge_criteria: Unresolved if any privileged account (adminCount=1) has an SPN; Resolved if none do.
steps.remediation: Remove SPNs from privileged accounts; use dedicated low-privilege accounts or a gMSA for services that require an SPN.

steps.label: NTLMv1 (LmCompatibilityLevel)
steps.description: Read LmCompatibilityLevel from the DC's remote registry (HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Lsa).
steps.judge_criteria: Resolved if LmCompatibilityLevel is 3 or higher, or the value is absent (modern Windows defaults to NTLMv2-only, effectively level 3, so an absent value means the deliberate weak setting was removed). Unresolved only if it is explicitly 0, 1, or 2.
steps.remediation: Set LmCompatibilityLevel to 5 (send NTLMv2 response only / refuse LM and NTLM) on all domain controllers and clients.

groups.name: Finding 3: LDAP signing / channel binding not enforced

steps.label: LDAP signing / channel binding
steps.description: Read the DC's LDAP host banner (a plain authenticated nxc ldap run prints signing / channel-binding status — no module needed; ldap-checker is deprecated).
steps.judge_criteria: Read the host banner nxc ldap prints. Resolved if it shows LDAP signing Enforced/Required AND channel binding Required; Unresolved if it shows signing:None or channel binding not enforced (e.g. 'No TLS cert'). Wording varies by NetExec version.
steps.remediation: Set LDAP server signing to Require signing and enforce LDAP channel binding on all domain controllers; consider LDAPS.
